name: The Crab Pot
tradition: The Mallet Smash now starts every Baltimore home game: a former Crab Pickers defender raises the giant wooden mallet at midfield, cracks the ceremonial shell, and lets the scoreboard reveal the score-prediction pieces before kickoff.

cue.label: Mallet Smash
cue.pregameLine: The giant mallet is raised at midfield, and the ceremonial shell is already cracking under the lights.
cue.crowdResponse: The Pickers answer with a sideways PICK! IT! PICK! IT! shuffle that turns every third down into a street-corner dare.
